rationale: Clear case-specific chain with ancestry-appropriate LD, conditional signals, missing-input inventory, colocalization versus horizontal effects, allele-versus-element-versus-gene distinctions, dose-matched phenocopy/rescue and context-aware negative results. No unsupported G/H assignment or material omission identified for this essay.
reference_guardrails: Judge this as a 1500-word conceptual essay, not a full experimental protocol. The supplied packet is synthetic and contains no numeric locus results.
The draft retains references to old multiple-choice choices and a sequencing-only claim absent from the final prompt. Do not demand rejection of an unasked WGS claim for full credit.

The lead SNP may itself be causal; calling it a marker does not establish noncausality. Controlled GWAS supports an associated locus under assumptions, not absolute proof of a direct causal mechanism.
A statistical credible set contains variants, not effector genes. Membership or proximity cannot alone assign a target; define coverage per model/signal and account for multiple effects.

High LD limits resolution; only exact collinearity creates the simple non-identifiability limit. Do not equate an arbitrary r-squared threshold or near-perfect LD with impossibility at any sample size.
Colocalization supports shared genetic signals, not molecular mediation. Absent evidence differs from evidence against a shared signal; context, power, priors and multiple signals matter.
Fine mapping, colocalization and functional assays are complementary and may inform each other. No fixed order or availability of a molecular QTL is universally necessary.

Allelic-expression measurement alone is observational. Allele editing, element deletion and gene loss/gain answer different questions; phenocopy alone does not establish mediation, and knockout alone does not establish sufficiency.
Use signal-specific joint/conditional models and appropriate ancestry/variant coverage. Removing a lead marker does not guarantee either persistence or disappearance of every true effect.
Reference simplifications are clarified in this review metadata; original frozen keys and all candidate responses remain unchanged. No raw-data execution is claimed.
